location: The University of Texas at Dallas (UTD)

about.description: HackUTD, the largest university hackathon in Texas, is a weekend-long event where students build apps, hardware, and more. HackUTD provides a venue for self-expression and creativity through technology. People with varying technical backgrounds from universities all over the US come together, form teams around a problem or idea, and collaboratively build a unique solution from scratch. Whether you're a frequent hackathon attendee or just getting started, we'd love to see what you can make!

keynoteSpeaker.name: Gen Fukunaga
keynoteSpeaker.title: Founder of Funimation
keynoteSpeaker.bio: Gen Fukunaga, a pioneering Japanese-American entrepreneur, founded Funimation and brought anime hits like Dragon Ball and My Hero Academia to North America, transforming the anime landscape. He stepped down as president and chairman in 2019, leaving a lasting legacy.

challengeTracks.title: Frontier Challenge Track

prizes.first: Apple TV + Digital Gift Card $100 per team member
prizes.third: Digital Gift Card $50 per team member

challengeTracks.description: Our customers enjoy our blazing-fast, reliable internet but from time to time have issues that can be fixed easily or would likely benefit from other value-added services we provide. We’re looking for ways to intelligently recommend products to our customers. Your challenge is to develop an app that helps recommend products the customer could benefit from. Want to take it to the next level? Include an augmented reality or Generative AI (GenAI) component! We will provide data and a data dictionary to gain insights on customer behavior such as number of devices, bandwidth utilization and power drops as well as Frontier’s product catalog to create product recommendations.

challengeTracks.title: Infosys Challenge Track

prizes.first: Airpods Pro 2 Fast-Track consideration for Infosys InStep Summer Internship in Richardson, TX (internship valued at $8000.)

challengeTracks.description: Infosys is on the cutting-edge of leveraging Generative AI to create innovative products and solutions. Develop a RAG-based intelligent smart knowledge assistant for the financial services industry. Solutions should use the agentic framework and should be capable of autonomously retrieving updated and contextually relevant information from multiple sources and generate concise, accurate responses.

challengeTracks.title: Pinata Challenge Track
challengeTracks.description: Pinata makes file storage and retrieval incredibly simple, freeing you from wrestling with complex AWS S3 setups and tricky IAM policies. We’re challenging teams to unleash their creativity and build the most unique, game-changing full-stack application using only Pinata—no external databases allowed. Show us how you can push boundaries and create something that truly stands out!

challengeTracks.title: Samba Nova Challenge Track
challengeTracks.description: Build an app that instills these values of speed and efficiency to improve human and/or machine productivity. Be sure to use our SambaNova Cloud API to qualify for competition and potentially win a prize.

challengeTracks.title: Veolia Challenge Track

prizes.second: EPOMAKER Ajazz AK820 Pro 75% Mechanical Keyboard

challengeTracks.description: Over the next 24 hours, your team is tasked with designing and prototyping a solution that addresses issues such as smart water conservation, renewable energy integration, energy efficiency in buildings, the interdependency between water and energy, or decentralized renewable energy systems. Use your creativity and technological expertise to develop a solution that makes a significant impact on sustainability and contributes to a more sustainable future for all

challengeTracks.title: Toyota Challenge Track
challengeTracks.description: Build an app that helps Toyota employees analyze vehicle fuel economy data for the years 2021-2025

challengeTracks.title: Goldman Sachs Challenge Track
challengeTracks.description: Challenge: Create an app (or website) that can provide financial services to individuals with limited access to traditional banks. Some examples of services that could be included are banking, payments, investment opportunities, and fraud detection. Technology Trends: Mobile banking, Digital wallets, AI, Blockchain

challengeTracks.title: Hydrate Detection Challenge
challengeTracks.description: Imagine you are a lease operator at EOG, tasked with ensuring optimal production from a group of wells. One of the challenges you face is the formation of hydrates (ice-like solids made of frozen natural gas) that can form inside pipelines and block the injection of gas. This blockage can significantly reduce oil production and potentially lead to costly well shutdowns. As a lease operator, your goal is to efficiently monitor these wells and quickly identify any instances of hydrate formation. You have access to data streams that include the current gas injection volume, target gas injection volume, and valve open percentage. Your challenge is to develop a solution that makes it easy and quick to detect when a hydrate occurs, allowing the lease operator to take swift action to minimize production loss. Extension: With an additional day of data, enhance your solution by predicting when a hydrate is likely to form. Github Link: https://github.com/nihaal419/HackUTD-RippleEffect

challengeTracks.title: CBRE Challenge Track
challengeTracks.description: For this year's challenge, hackers are asked to build a web or mobile application that assists our U.S. property managers operate more sustainable office buildings for our tenants, resulting in cost savings & reduced carbon impact.

challengeTracks.title: Design Track
challengeTracks.description: Everyone loves a pretty interface, but apps and ideas are often created with little thinking in regards to their users. This track will be judged not only on how good your project submission looks from a UI perspective, but also on how much the design of the application showcases your thought behind the UX (user experience).

challengeTracks.title: PNC Challenge Track
challengeTracks.description: As organizations increasingly rely on data to drive decision-making, ensuring a clear understanding of how data is created, accessed, moved, and used is critical for security, performance, and governance. Yet, many organizations struggle to maintain visibility into these data flows, leading to inefficiencies, security risks, and compliance challenges. We challenge you to design an innovative solution that enhances the observability of data patterns throughout its lifecycle. Your solution should allow organizations to monitor and analyze how data is created, accessed, moved, and used – with business context.

faq.question: Where will it be?
faq.answer: HackUTD will be hosted at... You guessed it: UT Dallas! Parking and other logistical details for attendees will be provided closer to the hackathon date.

faq.question: Free swag? pls?
faq.answer: We will have custom HackUTD 2024 swag for all participants along with gear provided by our sponsors! And free food!

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: HackUTD 2024 will be completely free to hackers!

faq.question: What are the general rules?
faq.answer: Your project must be built entirely over the course of the weekend. No previous projects or code may be used. Have fun! Your behavior at this event is subject to the MLH Code of Conduct as well as any applicable UT Dallas guidelines.

faq.question: Can I participate if I have never hacked?
faq.answer: Everyone is welcome to come, and no experience is necessary to attend! We will even be hosting workshops to introduce new hackers to industry programs and technologies.

faq.question: Does HackUTD cover travel?
faq.answer: HackUTD does do travel reimbursement! Check our policies here!

faq.question: What do I need to bring?
faq.answer: You just need to bring a laptop, charger, and a hacking spirit to participate! We also recommend having a compiler, packages, or any packaging tools ready beforehand. We will be providing internet connectivity, and will also have free food throughout the event!

faq.question: Does HackUTD accept walk-ins?
faq.answer: Historically HackUTD has taken limited walk-ins. We anticipate to take walk-ins again this year but will be subject to venue capacity!

faq.question: When do applications open?
faq.answer: Applications are OPEN now! Click Apply at the top of the page!

faq.question: What if I don’t have a team?
faq.answer: We will have a teambuilding session at the start of the hackathon for those who need help finding one! You can also choose to work on projects by yourself.

faq.question: What is a hackathon?
faq.answer: A hackathon is a 24-hour competition where you and up to 3 teammates build a software project from scratch and compete against other groups for prizes. Sponsors will also provide workshops, events, and activities throughout the weekend to help you learn more about the field of technology!

faq.question: Can I volunteer?
faq.answer: Mentor and volunteer applications will be opening soon! Follow us on social media to be notified when applications open.

faq.question: What should I build?
faq.answer: Anything you want! You can try to solve a sponsor challenge or submit a project for the HackUTD awards!
